title: How Practo's Founders Went Clinic to Clinic Selling Software in 2009
conflicts: YourStory says Shashank had just graduated in 2008; Tech in Asia, SmartCEO and NIT Karnataka's department page (B.Tech batch of 2009) show both founders were still students, so the story says student. Funding: about INR 10 lakh from friends and family (Tech in Asia) plus an undisclosed Morpheus seed in July 2009 (SmartCEO); Shashank calls the company bootstrapped in 2009; funding set to 'mixed' rather than the slate's 'venture'.
notes: Episode dated 2009 (Practo Ray launch and the switch from online sign-ups to clinic-by-clinic selling), with the 2008 origin as setup. Tech in Asia says the company was 'then called Turbodoc.in' while SmartCEO says Practo Technologies was set up in 2008; the company field is simply 'Practo'. YourStory live page is 403, cited via the Internet Archive. Quote stance: affirms.
